summary.one_liner: CodiMD is an open-source, self-hostable real-time collaborative markdown note editor, the free software version of HackMD.
summary.what_it_does: CodiMD lets multiple people collaborate on markdown documents in real time. It is built on the HackMD source code and is meant for hosting a team's or community's content on your own server. The README says it is the free software version of HackMD with reduced features (book mode is omitted). The README points to external documentation covering Docker deployment, manual deployment, configuration (networking, security, performance, privacy, image storage, authentication), upgrading, migrating from Etherpad, and developer setup with webpack. Browser support is listed for Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Opera and Android Browser at various minimum versions.
how_to_run: See the CodiMD documentation for Docker deployment (linked from the README, not included in it)
For contributing or development, follow the manual deployment guide linked from the README
notable: Free software fork of HackMD with reduced features (no book mode)
caveats: Reduced feature set compared to HackMD, with no book mode
Setup and configuration details live in external documentation, not the README
Upgrading from earlier versions requires following a separate guide
